title: The Geometry of Force and Silence
subtitle: A guided journey through gauge fields, quantum existence, and the mass gap
status: Open Millennium Prize Problem; constructive quantum-field obligation; no mass-gap proof claim
claim_boundary: Browser-native, source-normalized exposition of four-dimensional quantum Yang–Mills existence and mass gap. Classical solutions, instantons, perturbation theory, asymptotic freedom, finite-lattice models, strong-coupling expansions, numerical glueball spectra, supersymmetric theories, and confinement heuristics are not substituted for an axiomatic nontrivial continuum theory with a positive spectral gap.
